reply_text:
I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent Pree the list in our DM:

- **#4409**, from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard.
- **#4412**, from the same digest. It's a driver text-message prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
- **PD-5302**, from #central-random this week. Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up ticket.

**Possible fourth ticket:** I also flagged **#8841** (#central-random, 13 Oct). Hollis linked it to "Tobias's dealer account," and Moss's digest says the dealer account Marrow Fieldworks changed hands in January. Nobody names the account in that chat, though, so I told Pree I can't confirm it's Fieldworks and suggested checking with Tobias.

**Left out on purpose:** PD-4821 and FR-882, because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a separate account.

**Where I looked:** Pree is a member of #central-random, #central-team and our DM, so I read all three. I also read both of Moss's Central digests, which are public. "This week's chat" turned up nothing beyond #central-random: #central-team has had no messages this week and the DM only has this request. I didn't search across all messages, because results would include conversations Pree can't see.
